cases.name: PCB typing in editable surfaces issues zero commands/history writes and preserves API model hash
cases.assertions: Synthetic R/G/H/N/C/U/Delete/Backspace and Ctrl/Meta+A/Z/Y in fixture textarea, select and nested contenteditable leave mock command/history counts zero and mock projection SHA-256 unchanged.

cases.name: PCB focused exact action runs once; consumed, IME, repeat and wrong modifiers stay inert
cases.assertions: IME, legacy keyCode 229, repeated, consumed and extra-modifier events issue no commands; intentional focused R dispatches one rotation and changes mock placement rotation to 90 degrees.

cases.name: open modal blocks leaked canvas focus; focus loss cancels tool before module remount
cases.assertions: Fixture aria-modal blocks synthetic design keys despite leaked canvas focus; outside focus cancels measure; held Shift state does not survive editor unmount/remount.

cases.name: schematic typing stays inert; focused select-all/delete dispatches once
cases.assertions: Fixture textarea events leave model/history unchanged; focused Ctrl/Meta+A and Delete dispatch exactly one schematic delete. Unsupported R/Shift+R remain inert.

cases.name: owned route HUD portal retains session while typing width; outside focus abandons it
cases.assertions: Route HUD width editing retains the route session and issues no design/history commands; outside focus abandons it and a stale pointer event cannot commit.

cases.name: canvas-owned route menu retains session; Escape closes only menu and Finish writes once
cases.assertions: Owned PCB route menu keeps the route; Escape closes only that menu and restores canvas focus; Finish Route dispatches one mock route command.

cases.name: leaving owned route menu or changing editor discards stale callbacks without writes
cases.assertions: Outside focus or editor change discards route callbacks without command/history changes; another owner's menu survives this editor unmount.

cases.name: schematic primitive menu retains rotation actions without unsupported R hints
cases.assertions: Schematic primitive menu has rotation actions without unsupported R hints; clockwise click dispatches exactly one mock rotation command.

findings.historicalScope: Shared guard adoption across PCB/schematic, Home N, Settings Escape and Library wizard Escape; broader H06 scope also includes Library editors, Assistant and all window/document listeners.
findings.currentEvidence: Shared guard ownership, IME/repeat/composed-path checks and the eight real-canvas fixture cases pass. Home/Settings consumers changed in the commit but these eight cases do not mount those screens.
findings.remaining: Full consumer audit and real Library/editor/native acceptance, nested dirty-dialog Escape ordering and persistent design hashes remain outstanding.

findings.historicalScope: Assistant/comment text corruption, selected trace/pad/placement deletion or rotation, design undo instead of text undo, and Export-dialog background tool/layer/deletion commands.
findings.currentEvidence: Actual PCB/Schematic canvas listeners are mounted with generic editable fields and a generic modal. Zero mocked writes and unchanged in-memory hashes cover the guarded paths; intentional actions and owned portal/menu lifecycle also pass.
findings.remaining: Re-run actual Assistant composer, comment composer/thread, free-pad inspector and Export dialog on an isolated database; verify typed text, native undo, command/history counts, persisted design hashes and save/reopen.

limitations: Passing focused regressions do not establish a fresh reproduction verdict for either whole archived root or change historical alias verdicts/severities.
The fixture textarea is labelled Assistant draft but is not the actual Assistant dock or comment/thread composer; the fixture select is not the production free-pad inspector.
Synthetic keydown dispatch checks shortcut suppression, not character insertion, typo correction, native select behavior, native text undo/select-all, physical IME input or OS keyboard delivery.
The modal is a generic aria-modal fixture, not production Export/rules/import dialogs. Nested dirty-wizard/dialog Escape ordering and all focus-return paths are not qualified.
Library import wizard, symbol/footprint editors, other editable consumers and an exhaustive window/document listener audit remain unqualified by these cases.
No SQLite writes, persisted projection hashes, save/reopen, crash/restart, packaged Electron, Windows native shortcuts or original archived design/screenshot reruns were performed here.
Historical r/o/t/f/b/z and other swallowed-character combinations are not all enumerated by the eight blocked-key set; no complete text-preservation claim follows.
Command counts and model hashes are observed at the mocked HTTP boundary. Browser success cannot prove transactional or manufacturing correctness.
